description: Breach row §6.2 passphrase + localStorage (same device): NO. The test takes each component from a live system after real unlocks — the browser's localStorage and IndexedDB as the browser left them, the Redis keys as they are, the bbolt file copied while the lab core is stopped (DEFAULT 63) — and tries to decrypt the user's credentials with everything it holds; an implementation that leaks Part 1 into Redis, keeps the hash on disk or caches credentials in the browser fails it. The YES rows (passphrase + bbolt, the full server) are not tested (phase-04 exit 4).
